UserPublicProfile.title: UserPublicProfile
UserPublicProfile.description: Authenticated laboratory user public profile metadata without raw PII.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

displayName.description: Display name of the laboratory researcher.

providerId.description: Primary authentication provider identifier (e.g., google.com, facebook.com, password).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

AnalysisRecord.title: AnalysisRecord
AnalysisRecord.description: Cloud-synced coproparasitological slide analysis summary belonging to a specific user.

ownerId.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the analysis owner.

associatedIllness.description: Possible associated clinical condition or illness.

candidateCount.description: Number of localized bounding boxes on the slide.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated.

/users/{userId}/analyses/{analysisId}.description: Owner-restricted subcollection of cloud-saved microscopic slide analysis summaries.
